description: This file defines Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) for a tax calculation API, including data structures for tax lines, requests, and responses.

classes.name: TaxDtos
classes.description: Container class for tax calculation related data transfer objects.

classes.name: TaxLine
classes.description: Represents a single line item used for tax calculation, including SKU, quantity, and unit price.

classes.name: TaxCalculateRequest
classes.description: Represents the payload for requesting tax calculations, containing store ID and list of tax lines.

classes.name: TaxCalculateResponse
classes.description: Represents the response from tax calculation, including store ID, tax rate, taxable amount, and tax amount.

methods.name: TaxDtos()
methods.description: Private constructor to prevent instantiation of the utility class.
